normative_claims.text: HG-KSEOS is the sole admission/WorkOrder/evidence/release control plane; Hermes is the governed runtime/orchestration plane; Fabric is a contract surface. A native PROMPT_COMPILE_PASS must precede any product write.
The published v0.1.0-preview.2 SHA256SUMS lists three assets while the README quickstart fetches one, so a verbatim copy-paste of `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` exits non-zero with two unreadable entries.
compute_profile does not refuse duplicate axes and counts len(list) while the emitted ProfileBinding record de-duplicates, so the escalation basis and the shipped record can disagree.

The identity fields subject_id/version/content_hash/schema_version and the PI trace property are declared as empty schemas, so no JSON type is enforced and str() coercion in the semantic layer cannot substitute for it.

No risk score or veto evidence reaches compute_profile, so LITE cannot imply that a per-axis risk assessment ran; the honest output is an explicit not-assessed marker, never a manufactured LOW_RISK_VERIFIED.
The 8 skills exist as repository sources but no separate Web/ChatGPT mount package has been published, and a chat upload of markdown is not a native skill installation.
PIPD-LIFECYCLE-SPEC@1.1.0 is the external canonical SSOT; the runtime repository must publish a pinned derived index instead of creating a competing master copy.
preview.1 and preview.2 ship the same distribution version 0.1.0 with different bytes; an immutable tag is never rewritten, so any successor must be a new PEP 440 prerelease identity.
The round ceiling is REPAIR_CANDIDATE_ONLY: DESIGNED != INSTALLED != EXECUTED != VERIFIED != RELEASED; the maker never issues INDEPENDENT_PASS, release or production.

intent.goal: Execute one minimal post-release maintenance round on the published S4 open-source MVP: repair the README checksum/onboarding defect, ship one versioned ChatGPT/Web mount package, close the identity-type and profile fail-closed contract gaps, and land a pinned normative source map with a replayable minimal self-bootstrap example - without moving the immutable tag.
intent.user_expected_outcome: A first-time user copy-pastes the README from a clean directory and every line exits 0 on both bash and PowerShell; a Web consumer can mount one ZIP and get sourced candidate answers; malformed identity/trace/profile inputs are refused by exact first-fail type checks; the repository states where its normative sources live without creating a second SSOT.
intent.user_expected_experience: The user only needs a shell, Python >= 3.11 and a ZIP upload; they never need to know WorkOrder, Skill or provider identifiers.
explicit_constraints: NARROW_REPAIR: keep the 19 schema families, 8 logical skills, 13 CLI commands, 5 web / 3 host projections and the clause-bound PI/PD trunk intact.
The native prompt compiler must actually run; a failure or a missing bundle means PROMPT_COMPILE_BLOCKED with read-only preflight only.
The sealed EXECUTE lane bounds the writer by write scope, not by prose.
Claims do not inherit: LOCAL_TESTED != INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTED != RELEASED.
Publication of a new tag or release asset stays an owner gate.
non_goals: No rewrite of the 11 PKG or 10 DOC documents; no second authority stack, reducer, plan IR or scheduler.
No S5 HGK live receiver, S6 GENIE, S7 JIT, S8 SWOF promotion, PRE-W3 or the 22 inactive external technologies.

No rewrite of historical FAIL receipts or previous independent attestations.
